candidates.source_name: 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) / Epistle of Enoch (1 Enoch 91-108)
candidates.draft_body:
1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Epistle of Enoch (1 Enoch 91-108) (c. 100 BC)

'In those days the Lord bade them to summon and testify to the children of earth concerning their wisdom: Show it unto them; for ye are their guides, and a recompense over the whole earth. For I and My son will be united with them for ever in the paths of uprightness in their lives' — 'I and My son' ('Adam wäldǝya in Ge'ez) — one of the rare and theologically loaded pre-Christian 'son' references in Second Temple literature. Tewahedo Christology reads this verse Christologically as anticipating the Father-Son union with the redeemed (Jn 14:23, 17:21-23) — pre-canonical witness to the Trinitarian inclusion-pattern.
